name: Curated entity block
description: Blocks where an editor hand-picks and orders existing entities, rendered in one view mode. A View defines the selectable pool and the allowed view modes.

suggests.drupal/canvas: Place curated blocks per page in the Canvas page builder.
suggests.drupal/custom_elements: Render the curated entities into Custom Elements for a decoupled frontend.

project_description: Provides blocks where an editor hand-picks and orders existing content entities and renders them in one chosen view mode (typically a teaser variant). A site builder defines the selectable pool and the allowed view modes through a View, so the same block type can be reused for many curation scenarios such as featured articles, editor's picks or a hand-sorted spotlight. The blocks are placeable anywhere blocks are supported, including Drupal Canvas and Block Layout. Optionally, when the custom_elements module is installed, each picked entity can be emitted as a Custom Element for a decoupled Lupus Decoupled frontend.
